programmes.d: Gem’s family has suddenly gone bankrupt and she is forced to stay with Sabrina.
It’s time for Sabrina’s wisdom teeth to come out. She doesn’t want to experience it the mortal way so she opts to have them removed magically.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: To Have and to Hold Back
programmes.d: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mermaid Magic
programmes.d: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Power Play
programmes.d: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the café. Cleo's caught in the crossfire with Kim when Samantha moves in and puts her stamp on the Sertori home.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Dark Side
programmes.d: Rikki's frustrated by the water attacks and goes to Mako Island on a full moon to confront the strange force in the Moon Pool. With Cleo and Bella delayed, Will pursues her and discovers she's been affected by the experience.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Magnetic Attraction
programmes.d: Cleo's introduced to Ryan, a young geophysicist who's working for Samantha. Rikki doesn't react well to Cleo consulting Ryan about the Mako rock and a fracture begins to appear in the trio.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Into the Light
programmes.d: Rikki fears Ryan's explorations on Mako Island will uncover their secrets but Cleo and Bella discount her concern. She almost goes too far trying to stop Ryan from discovering the crystals in the Moon Pool.
During a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Gus' powers mysteriously begin to fail while fending off Zarlak's forces. Investigation reveals that the magic-loss is affecting Gus' whole Elfin family.

Kasimir is stunned when she loses a Scootsoomer race to Lucrezia. Gus thinks Kazz is obsessed with winning and refuses to listen when Kazz says she thinks Lucrezia cheated. Kazz discovers a Leprechaun was forced to help her cheat and Zarlak.
The Enchanted School gets more than they expected when their new Librarian arrives. Aside from his immense knowledge of books, Professor Begelboyce brings tales of fantastic exploits.

Cassy is doing a report for Wish Giving Class when a powerful force from center-earth steals all her visual aides. We learn right away that it's Zarlak. He has coerced the legendary Ring of The Blue Moon.
Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. He works out she’s still a mermaid and tries to win her back. Cleo becomes suspicious of Lewis spending time with Charlotte.
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Marshall and a friend each want to win the heart of the same girl, who has a heart condition that brings her to Eerie hoping to have a transplant.
Marshall worries about his friend who becomes obsessed with heavy metal music to cope with a father who continually berates him.
Self-centered and conceited Prince Charming has only two goals in life: to look maahvelous, daaahling, and to reach the castle of Sleeping Beauty in order to kiss her out of her spell.
Craig and William are just about the only two people left who care about Rottmuckers Wax Museum and its collection of classic monsters.
Young Peters birthday is coming up, and he's looking forward to spending the weekend with his overworked father, a scientist at the local museum.

Wendell the nerd never wanted any trouble. In fact, he did everything he could to fit in and earn the respect of tough jock Rex Reavis and his friends, including dismissing all their cruel practical jokes with a shrug and a laugh.
When the two daughters of an old friend of Cyril's receive Turkish Love Charms, they are mysteriously swept away by Whirling Dervishes.
When the statue of the Toltec Raingod is stolen from a Global Warming conference in Mexico City, the BION team gives chase in the ARV, only to be sideswiped by the sudden appearance of a tornado!
When a jar believed to contain anti-aging cream of the Pharaohs is stolen from a Ripley exhibit, the BION team travels to Moscow.
Diving in minisubs off the coast of North Carolina with famed treasure hunter Bill Robinson, the BION team digs up a shield belonging to the ancient order of the Knights of the Crusades.
Lycanthrope terrorists take over an exclusive country club, and Blaze and Logan must descend to an underground, cold war missile base to investigate...
Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding...
In an exciting challenge match for Battle Bladers, six bladers are pitted against each other at the same time.
When Phoenix save Gingka's Bey Pointer from Tetsuya's claws, Gingka must battle Phoenix as a reward, and loses ALL his points.
Gingka has to create a new special move when battling his new opponent Teru whose former ballet skills make him an incredible blader.
Tsubasa sneaks into the Dark Nebula but he is caught by Doji who makes him battle many Dark Nebula bladers to earn his freedom.

When Lua is captured and brainwashed into releasing the ancient demon Chiros, it's up to Jason and Kong to defend the island from the evil monster.
Jason, Tann, Lua and Kong travel to New York to find out who is stealing ancient tablets connected to the Primal Stones.

When Sonic saves a female hedgehog named Breezie, he falls in love. Sonic does not know that Breezie is a robot that Dr. Robotnik created to keep Sonic occupied while he floods a city near his fortress.
Moose is close to being cut from the football team unless he is able to bring his grades up.

Archie and the gang get a taste of what it's like to deal with teenagers when Mr. Weatherbee, Mr. Lodge and Miss Grundy drink bottles of contaminated water, causing them to revert to their wild teenage selves.
Archie is temporarily unable to type, so Reggie offers to write the Weird Mystery article for the school paper.
A monstrous man of incredible strength is making evening appearances in Riverdale.

'Ice Blue Pink': When the daredevil Pink Panther skis into a mountain crevasse, he discovers an ice-encased Neanderthal blue panther. 'Pink Trek': Starship commander Captain Pink and Voodoo Man try to defeat the villainous Bird the Merciless.

'The Legend of El Pinko': When the Headless Jalapeno terrorizes the people of an old California village, El Pinko must come to the rescue. 'Pink Big': While working as a lab assistant to professor Von Schmarty, Pinky develops a super growth formula.
A film about a mean and violent werewolf is shot in Wolverton. Outraged by the poor misrepresentation of werewolves, Scott decides to be a stuntman in order to change the horror film into a comedy.
Scott becomes infatuated with Shayna the She-Wolf, a T.V. personality who he believes to be a real teen wolf, like himself. He and Stiles decide to travel to Hollywood and find her.
Mr. Bean is driven to distraction by diabolical decibels. Mr. Bean’s tranquillity is shattered by deafening roadworks outside his bedroom window.
Mr. Bean finds himself with more than a spring in his step. Mr. Bean likes nothing more than to relax on his sofa with a good meal and his favourite telly programme.

A puzzling puzzle has Mr. Bean truly puzzled. In a dark and cobwebby corner of his attic, Mr. Bean finds a treasure map. The hunt is on! But tricky clues lead Bean up the chimney, round the bend, down the garden path.

Mr. Bean needs to let a room but no one will let him. After a regrettable episode involving his landlady sleepwalking into his room, Mr. Bean suddenly finds himself out on his ear with nowhere to live.
When Harvey can’t make the wrestling team, Sabrina uses Dragon Spray to help him.
Gem and Sabrina are teamed up to work on a book report.
